description: This file defines the ForYouViewModel class in an Android app, which manages UI state and user interactions related to personalized news feeds, onboarding, deep links, and synchronization features using Kotlin coroutines and Android architecture components.

classes.name: ForYouViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel managing personalized news feed, onboarding, deep link handling, and sync state for the 'For You' feature in the app. Injected with repository and utility classes, it exposes flow-based UI state and provides functions to update preferences and handle deep links.

methods.name: updateTopicSelection
methods.description: Updates the follow state of a specific topic for the user.

methods.name: updateNewsResourceSaved
methods.description: Bookmarks or unbookmarks a news resource for the user.

methods.name: setNewsResourceViewed
methods.description: Marks a news resource as viewed.

methods.name: onDeepLinkOpened
methods.description: Handles deep link opening, logs the event, updates view status, and clears the link from saved state.

methods.name: dismissOnboarding
methods.description: Sets the onboarding process to be hidden for the user.
